R7 (Envelope): The design specifies an envelope of -35 <= x <= 35. The 'Front' view shows the part width extending from approximately -30 to +30, which is within limits, but the 'Top' view and bounding box data indicate a mismatch in how the X-axis extent was handled relative to the design intent.
summary: The rendered part fails to implement all required motor mounting holes and base screw holes as specified in the design document.
